notes.title: Devil and the Fairy leaves Early Access
notes.content:
We want to announce that Devil and the Fairy will leave Early Access.

Firstly, we thank everyone who supported this game in its Early Access phase, played it, and saw the potential it had. Unfortunately, for a multitude of reasons we were not able to turn this game into what it could have been, and we will officially stop updating it.

But we still think that Devil and the Fairy can be a fun and enjoyable experience, thus it will stay available on Steam at the same price as it was in Early Access.
We once again thank all our supporters and hope that you will keep on having fun with this title.

Have fun!
